reason: Events sent by venues in reply to the October 2026 outreach (Nighthawk Vineyards, Summerland Heritage Cider, The Office Brewery, Priest Creek), each from the venue's own email of 2026-10-15 and linked to its listing.

events.name: A Very Nighthawk Christmas
events.description: Nighthawk Vineyards' annual holiday weekend, part of the Okanagan Falls Winery Association's Holiday Cheer. The winery opens from 12 to 3 p.m. on both days, its last weekend before closing for the winter.

events.name: Light Up The Vines
events.description: Summerland Heritage Cider's holiday evening event at the cidery on Johnson Street, on three nights in late November and early December.
events.source_name: Summerland Heritage Cider Company (email from Lauren Vollo, 2026-10-15)

events.name: Halloween Cocktail Flight at The Office Brewery
events.description: The Office Brewery's Halloween cocktail flight, available at the Clement Avenue taproom during opening hours until Halloween.
events.source_name: The Office Brewery (email from Maggie McCarron, 2026-10-15)

events.name: Movies in the Vineyard
events.description: Outdoor movie nights among the vines at Priest Creek Family Estate Winery, every Friday and Saturday in October from 6:30 p.m. See the winery's events page for the films and tickets.
events.source_name: Priest Creek Family Estate Winery (email from Margarita, 2026-10-15)
